resolution_limit: 1080p maximum; do not enable any 2160p quality
language_note: Radarr's single preferred-language setting cannot guarantee English OR Hindi OR dual audio by itself. Use Original/English as the language preference if English is your default, and use the dual-audio Custom Format score as a preference. Confirm audio tracks after download.
important_notes: This JSON is a setup reference, not a direct Radarr quality-profile import file.
Import each Custom Format JSON separately in Settings > Custom Formats > Import.
After importing, open Settings > Profiles, edit/create the profile, add each Custom Format and set the scores listed here.
In the profile, only enable 1080p and optionally 720p qualities; leave all 2160p/4K qualities disabled.
Set the cutoff to Bluray-1080p (or your preferred 1080p group) and enable upgrades.
Custom Format title matching is imperfect: HDR/IMAX/Dual Audio tags may be absent or inconsistently named in releases.
Do not use a negative score as a substitute for disabling 2160p qualities; disable 2160p directly.
